posts.title: Above and Beyond
posts.description: Although I’m neurotically driven to save much of Michael Lewis’ work for some optimal time in the future, one book has triggered this rainy-day mentality above the rest. Many readers consider The Undoing Project to be Lewis’ best work to date, so I, ever the rationalist, have avoided it. It’s perverse, I know. I’m working on it.
